name: partiu
description: Self-hosted flight tracker — a TripIt alternative. Parses airline confirmation emails into trips, tracking, stats and more.

paragraphs: Partiu is a self-hosted alternative to TripIt — a personal flight tracker PWA that automatically reads your airline confirmation emails, parses the flight details, and organises everything into trips. No third-party account needed, no data leaving your server.
features: Connects to Gmail (or any IMAP mailbox) and scans for flight confirmation emails
Parses booking details: flight number, airports, times, seat, cabin class, passenger name, booking reference
Built-in parser rules for 19 airlines (see Supported airlines)

Structural parsing only — every leg comes from a parser that knows the layout it is reading: the airline's own rule, or the shared GDS receipt parser. There is deliberately no generic "find a flight number and guess the…

Boarding-pass mails enrich the leg you already have: Lufthansa and LATAM passes fill seat, gate, terminal, cabin, booking reference and passenger on the stored flight — only fields that are still empty, and never a new…

whatItDoes.text: Partiu is a self-hosted alternative to TripIt — a personal flight tracker PWA that automatically reads your airline confirmation emails, parses the flight details, and organises everything into trips. No third-party account needed, no data leaving your server.

requirements.text: Username / password login with session cookies (30-day expiration, server-side revocable).
Login rate-limiting and TOTP lockout after repeated failures
CARTO now requires an API key for its tiles and stamps unkeyed ones with an "API KEY REQUIRED" watermark.
